product: External access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will soon be available…
tagline: Starting on or after December 10, 2026, external access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Starting on or after December 10, 2026, external access to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Supported external Delta clients can create, read, and write Unity Catalog managed Delta tables. Creating and writing managed Delta tables requires catalog commits.
